verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets docs describe outbound webhooks. They say it delivers "real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched" and that results arrive "through the dashboard, API, or webhooks", so the product itself ships an event-callback mechanism. The evidence covers only Websets, in two brief mentions, with no detail on how a consumer registers a webhook. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration endpoint/API, list of event types, payload/signature verification and retry semantics, webhooks for products beyond Websets (Search/Agent), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched
